rationale: A gives a clear recommendation and one useful supporting point, but it barely compares alternatives, lacks caveats, and offers limited decision structure. B also gives a concrete recommendation, and despite some fluff, it appears to frame KPIs, introduces an additional plausible option beyond the listed set, and includes failure modes/disconfirming evidence. Its quantitative support is imperfect and partly generic, but it better helps a careful decision-maker think through tradeoffs and reach constraints. B is more decision-useful overall because it is more discriminative and uncertainty-aware, not because it is longer.
